array.string: if ! /opt/homebrew/bin/pass-cli info >/dev/null 2>&1; then pat="$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s proton-pass-cli -a pat -w 2>/dev/null)" if [ -n "$pat" ]; then /opt/homebrew/bin/pass-cli logout --force >/dev/null 2>&1 PROTON_PASS_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$pat" /opt/homebrew/bin/pass-cli login fi fi exec /opt/homebrew/bin/pass-cli ssh-agent start --vault-name SSH --create-new-identities SSH --socket-path "$HOME/.ssh/proton-pass-agent.sock"
